title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDT-Margined KLAY Perpetual Contracts with Up to 25X Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch USDT-margined KLAY perpetual contracts with up to 25x leverage at 2021-10-12 03:30 AM (UTC). Please note: KLAY perpetual contracts are USDT-margined futures contracts that use USDT as collateral. Users will be able to select between 1-25x leverage.
